note: The seven houses of the University of Mzansi (build plan, Piece 0). This file is the only place a house is defined: add a row (or change a colour) and the building, its door, its banner, its common room, the creator, the student card and the profile all follow, with no code changes. main / accent: the house colours (door and banner, card stripe). place: the internal id of its building on the campus map (the older ids res_o, res_r, res_s, res_other and off_campus keep the activities already written for those buildings; a new house can use any new id, e.g. res_k). x, y: where its building stands, in the same 1000 x 1000 units as places.csv. model: the Kenney city building it uses (public/models/city). was: old residence names that now belong to this house (old saves move here).

houses.name: Wave House
houses.blurb: The loud house: music down the passage, noodles on the boil, and a party that starts in someone's room

houses.name: Peak House
houses.blurb: The quiet house: the corridor goes still after ten, and the common room is for reading

houses.name: Oakwinds House
houses.blurb: The courtyard house: soccer until the floodlight clicks off, then someone shares the fridge

houses.name: Goldrush House
houses.blurb: The busy house: more floors than anyone asked for, stairs that never end, and the person next door becomes yours

houses.name: Jakaranda House
houses.blurb: The creative house: purple blossoms on the path, paint on the stairs, and a playlist that never ends

houses.name: Kingsway House
houses.blurb: The sporty house: boots by the door, a match on the TV, and a rivalry with every other house

houses.name: Mzansi House
houses.blurb: The international house by the gate: students from everywhere, and a kitchen that smells of five countries
